cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put your club captaincy on our rematch. I'll put up my coaching post. Let's specify the handover before we play.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why risk our jobs? Pride should be enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've forgotten six results played for pride. Please choose a consequence we have to act on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One training session. The loser sets out the cones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make it the rest of the season. One session can be called a favor; a season goes on the rota. Shall I put both names against that agreement?

reason: A responds to B's practical small stake by enlarging its duration and formal effect, with reciprocal exposure stated.
